user.title: Connect to PatchMon
user.description: Use an Integration API credential with `host:get`. Optional username/password enables patch actions until PatchMon adds long-lived patching tokens (PR #596).

data_description.url: Base URL of the PatchMon server.
data_description.verify_ssl: Keep enabled unless your server uses an intentionally untrusted TLS certificate.

error.invalid_url: Enter a complete HTTP or HTTPS URL
error.missing_scope: The API credential needs the host:get scope
error.patch_credentials_incomplete: Enter both username and password, or neither
error.two_factor_required: Two-factor account cannot be used for unattended patch actions

data.monitor_patch_runs: Monitor latest patch run per host

data_description.include_packages: Fetch updates for each host with pending updates. Watched hosts always fetch their full package list.
data_description.monitor_patch_runs: Requires patch credentials and an enabled PatchMon patching module. Adds one API request per host per polling interval.
data_description.host_groups: Comma-separated PatchMon group names or UUIDs.

edit_host_packages.title: Watched packages for selected host
edit_host_packages.description: Enter exact package names separated by commas or new lines (e.g. openssl, nginx). Clear this field to stop tracking this host. The package must be installed and reported by PatchMon.
